description: Build a minimal valid ApexCharts options object for a given chart type. Picks the correct series data format (axis vs non-axis) and supplies placeholder data when none is given. Use this as the starting point for a chart. Since apexcharts 8.0 the Tier 2 types (waterfall, dumbbell, streamgraph, raincloud, violin, icicle, sunburst, unit, waffle) are outside the default bundle: the page also needs that type's add-on import next to 'apexcharts', or `import ApexCharts from 'apexcharts/full'`; apexcharts_list_types names the import per type.

horizontal.description: Render bars horizontally. Honored only for bar and dumbbell (column is vertical by definition).

series.description: Optional series data in the format required by the chart type.

stacked.description: Stack series. Honored only for bar, column, area and line chart types.

name: apexcharts_generate_config
title: Generate ApexCharts config
